recommendation_summary: Recommends shipping no new services or topics, and replacing the in-memory object counting with a PostgreSQL COUNT(*) query that keeps request-time committed-data freshness. It also says to check the query plan, add an index if needed, and measure latency under load. It adds no cache, event stream or projection now. The reply has none of the four record labels.
note: The recommendation is a correctly bounded aggregate-query fix, but all four record labels are missing, so every record predicate fails.
